mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, we are seeing clear skies and a temperature of 67 degrees at the Verona Public Library, though we do have a moderate air quality alert in effect with an index of 53.

The City of Verona has reached an important milestone with the unanimous adoption of the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-term roadmap for infrastructure and housing, while the Public Works department continues to provide essential updates on local utility and street maintenance.
There is plenty to do this weekend with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
In a notable incident reported by the police department, a 19-year-old man was arrested on October 3 for being a felon in possession of a firearm after an officer initiated a traffic stop.
You are in for a treat today at Culver's because the flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew, and you can stop by anytime before they close at 10:00 PM.
